C must clear the same comparison against B, not just run faster or fit a lower training loss.

comparison.limitations: Single training replica per arm; matching game seeds does not imply matching future actions or RNG consumption. Historical COMBAT30 has a different lower initialization and is descriptive context, not the causal control.

Historical within-rollout gradient variance does not measure independent-rollout noise.
